sources.entry: lexical.Art -AI image generation tool that allows you to create images from text descriptions. #free

summary.name: Lexica
summary.one_liner: Lexica is an AI image generation engine that creates images from text prompts, and the page shows a gallery of example prompts and results.
use_cases: find example prompts for ai art
make wallpapers or album-art style images
summary.what_it_does: The page is a gallery of AI image prompts, each shown as a truncated text description such as a Kirby wallpaper, a Portra 400 landscape, or an anime poster. The prompts cover a wide range of styles, including photorealistic selfies, 1990s anime, oil painting, and camera-specific looks like iPhone 6 flash or ARRI ALEXA Mini LF. The page text does not describe the generation process, model details, or how to sign up. The only tool description comes from the external listing, which says it creates images from text descriptions.
notable: Browsable gallery of community-style text prompts with example styles
Prompts reference specific camera, film, and art-style looks
caveats: Page text does not state pricing details; 'free' comes from the external listing only
Page text gives no information on features, limits, or model used
